Accessories: Wallets, bags, money clips, sunglasses and jewelry organizers: the everyday things your chosson or kallah will carry and use long after the wedding week.
Clothing: Cozy, wearable gifts like slippers, monogrammed socks and matching Mr & Mrs sweatshirts.
Cosmetics: Fragrances and beauty gifts for a special day of the week before the wedding, an anniversary or a Yom Tov.
Food: Fun treats to tuck in alongside a bigger gift. Always check the package for the hechsher you rely on.
Funny: Lighthearted gifts that add a laugh to the week before the wedding. They pair well with something sentimental.
Funny Cards: Playful cards to slip in with one of the seven gifts.
Gadgets: Useful tech gifts: earbuds, trackers, chargers, smart mugs and digital frames.
Games: Gifts to enjoy together, like custom puzzles made from your own photos.
Guitar: Personalized picks, cases, capos and straps for the guitarist in your life.
Home: Gifts for your new home together: personalized blankets, photo keepsakes, calendars, trays and decanters.
Kitchen: Gifts for cooking and hosting, from a recipe book for your Shabbos favorites to a sushi kit for a night in.
Nice Cards: Heartfelt, personalized cards to write a note for each day.
Outdoors: Gifts for time outside, personalized with your new family name.
Pickleball: Custom paddles, grip bands and playful gifts for the pickleball fan.
Travel: Smart luggage tags, organizers and passport holders for the honeymoon and every trip after.
Writing: Personalized journals, notebooks and engraved pens.
Anniversary Cards: Cards to tuck in with an anniversary gift: heartfelt ones that say it better than you could, and a few funny ones that will make your spouse laugh. All clean, all for the two of you.
Wedding Cards: Cards for the chosson and kallah, from warm to funny, so your gift arrives with the right words.
Wrapping Paper: Wrapping that makes the gift feel special before it is opened: matte gold, elegant reversible rolls and classic kraft with ribbon. Good for every day of the week before the wedding.
Cologne & Perfume: Fragrances worth giving: well-loved colognes from Montblanc, Armani and Dolce&Gabbana, the kind of bottle that becomes his signature scent.
Small Shops: Gifts from small, independent shops we love, from designer belts to one-of-a-kind pieces. These link straight to the shop's own website.
